description: A worker survives a conductor failure and keeps reporting under a lease generation that has since been superseded. Reports from the stale lease must not advance the task.
expected_observable: Recovery confirms termination of the prior process (or parks) and records termination evidence; the stale lease generation cannot advance the execution or produce an effect; only after reconciliation does a fresh claim dispatch the work, exactly once.

fixture_refs.lease: TaskId lease generation (LedgerApi::begin_lease); stale generation plants a live process-group leader record
